fields.title: Repeated-strike probability and approximation
fields.finding: The stored count is ln(2)/Pf. For independent equal-risk trials the exact real-valued 50% count is ln(2)/[-ln(1-Pf)]. The design case changes 61.224523/13.134564 to 60.877292/12.784859. Repeated identical loading of the same Weibull specimen is not automatically an independent trial.
fields.proposed_fix: Label the rare-event approximation and provide exact counts and integer ceilings: the 25 mm sectored-flexure lower bound is 485, not 484. Define strike location/damage history before treating counts as storm reliability.
